classification_basis: Review article; no independent primary programme is assigned before full-text source-role adjudication.
Dissertation may contain primary chapters and later-published dependent reports; independence must be adjudicated before a held-out programme can exist.
Two-population observational study includes herbivory and correlated floral traits, but one versus multiple ecological modifiers cannot be assigned from design metadata alone.
Three-population morph-stratified selection study; morph state and population context do not yet map cleanly to a registered ecological modifier class.
Source design prospectively crosses snowmelt timing with summer precipitation over three years and measures selection involving pollination and seed-predator escape; classification uses design only.
